episode_title: Wax EDU Changed My Perspective: The Power of Community, Sugaring & What's Coming to ELEVATE 2027

real_qa.q: What is Bright Intimate Brightening and how does it increase revenue for waxing services?
real_qa.r: Bright Intimate Brightening is a product line that helps reduce waxing discomfort by approximately 80% through pain-numbing and soothing steps, while also providing a three to six shade lighter improvement in skin tone immediately after waxing. The system costs $250 and can upgrade a $70 Brazilian wax to $250, or alternatively, the numb and soothe option provides a $20 upgrade that adds just five extra minutes to the service while reducing client pain and enabling faster appointment times.
real_qa.requete: Bright Intimate Brightening waxing revenue upsell

real_qa.q: What are the travel logistics and airport options for attending Elevate 2027 in Sedona?
real_qa.r: Attendees can fly into either Phoenix or Flagstaff airports. If flying into Phoenix, the drive to Sedona is approximately one hour and a half, and if flying into Flagstaff, it is a 30 to 45 minute drive to the Outbound Sedona resort. Flagstaff's airport hubs include Phoenix and Dallas, so West Coast travelers would typically fly into Phoenix first then take a connecting flight to Flagstaff.

real_qa.q: What is Prickly Bear Skincare and what makes its formulation unique?
real_qa.r: Prickly Bear Skincare is a five-step pre and post-care system specifically designed for waxing that Katie Wasserman has been formulating for the last three years with a chemist in New Jersey. The product line features a unique calm cacti complex and is officially launching in the US, with exclusive access for Elevate ticket holders receiving it as part of the Black Friday promotion.
real_qa.requete: Prickly Bear Skincare cacti complex pre-post wax care

real_qa.q: What educational certifications and live demonstrations will be featured at Elevate 2027?
real_qa.r: Elevate will showcase certifications and live demonstrations including Bright Intimate Brightening for intimate skin care after waxing, Crotch Cosmetics for vajayshal treatments post-wax, and Artistry Beauty's brow lamination, lash lifting and tinting for facial waxers. Katie is also working on securing additional brow educators, and attendees can get certified at discounted prices during the event.

real_qa.q: What is Sugar Guru Academy and how does it help estheticians learn sugaring?
real_qa.r: Sugar Guru Academy is an educational platform led by educator Myra that teaches sugaring techniques to estheticians of all levels, from beginners to experienced practitioners. According to Katie, Myra provides non-stressful instruction that helps estheticians fall in love with sugaring and understand how to incorporate it as a hybrid hair removal service alongside waxing.
real_qa.requete: Sugar Guru Academy Myra sugaring education certification

guest.titre: Owner of Flagstaff Skincare Med Spa and Prickly Bear Skincare
guest.bio_context: Katie Wasserman is an esthetician and business owner with over 15 years of experience in the beauty industry. She is the owner of Flagstaff Skincare Med Spa in Flagstaff, Arizona, and founder of Prickly Bear Skincare, a pro's hair removal line that she has been formulating for the last three years with a chemist in New Jersey. She hosts the podcast Beauty Talk Confessions and is organizing Elevate, a retreat-style event scheduled for 2027 in Sedona.
